name: Inflict Serious Wounds
summary: Deal 3d8 damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +15) to a touched creature, or heal an undead target for that amount.
description: Channel negative energy into the touched creature. Roll 3d8 and add 1 point per caster level, up to +15. A living target takes that much damage, halved on a successful Will save. An undead target instead regains that many hit points.
